description: This file defines a React functional component named Signup, which renders a user registration form. It manages form state using useState hooks, handles input changes, and submits registration data through an external authentication context's register function. The component also includes navigation via react-router-dom's useNavigate and Link components.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change events to update the form state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls the register method, and navigates on success or sets error message on failure.
